title: Field Supervisor, LD Clerk and More
summary: The Kerala Public Service Commission has released an Extra Ordinary Gazette dated 2026-11-16, announcing recruitment for various posts under different state departments and corporations. The application deadline for these posts, which include Systems Manager, Field Supervisor, and L.D. Clerk, is 2026-12-16.
